record.body:
## Orientation

Worktree: `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--plugin-dep-marketplace` on `phase/plugin-dep-marketplace`. Code commits only there; exclude `.artifacts`. Primary checkout `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow` owns the store. No parallel packaging executor. Do not edit `skills/`, `se_workflow/`, or `~/adaptive-artifacts`.

Requirements:
- R1: se-workflow's Claude plugin.json declares adaptive-artifacts as a plugin dependency (name required; version range optional but preferred when tags exist).
- R2: One Claude marketplace lists both plugins so installing se-workflow can resolve adaptive-artifacts without a second marketplace add and without allowCrossMarketplaceDependenciesOn.
- R3: That marketplace is hosted in the se-workflow repository: local ./ entry for se-workflow and a github (or equivalent) source entry for adaptive-artifacts.
- R4: README Install for Claude documents the single-marketplace path and matches the manifests.
- R5: Cursor install remains clone/sync (+ PATH for the AA binary) and does not claim Claude-style dependency auto-install.

Design invariants: No monorepo merge. Dependency resolves inside the se-workflow-hosted marketplace (no allowCrossMarketplaceDependenciesOn required for the happy path). AA remains installable on its own.

Design assumptions: Claude resolves github-sourced marketplace entries for the dependency install. Listing AA in both marketplaces does not confuse install ids for users who only use the se-workflow marketplace.

Decisions:
- marketplace-topology: shared-marketplace
- marketplace-host: se-workflow-hosts-both
record.subject: claude-shared-marketplace
